result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible navigation and layout inconsistencies that make the screen feel partially broken.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted in green while the screen clearly displays the restaurant discovery/home feed. The Home tab appears inactive despite home content being shown.
issues.suggestion: Highlight Home when this feed is active, or display the Profile screen if Profile is intended to be selected.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge, showing only a partial additional chip with no obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll behavior with a subtle fade/arrow indicator, or constrain the row so chips do not appear unintentionally clipped.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is visually obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving its content and metadata inaccessible at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scroll container so cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
